Title: Architecture review gate B
Purpose: Stop again after loader/DI and SQLite review work so architectural drift is caught before the codebase is split into smaller files.
Deliverables: Decision on unresolved DI or transaction debt
Updated traceability to remaining refactor tasks
ValidationCommands: Review architectural findings and ensure unresolved issues are visible, owned, and sequenced
ReviewQuestions: Did the design get more explicit and testable, or did new hidden coupling appear?
Are the remaining long-file refactors still worth doing after the prior hardening work?
Should the run proceed, branch corrective work, or stop?
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a corrective subbundle and rerun gate B before any file decomposition begins.
